hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Model the trading process with three distinct states: holding stock, in cooldown rest, or available to purchase.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: After selling stock on day d, purchasing is disallowed for the specified cooldown window of k days.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Maintain rolling historical profit values to enable buying immediately after the cooldown period expires.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxProfitWithCooldown(prices: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    if not prices:
        return 0

    n = len(prices)
    hold = -prices[0]
    sold = [0] * (k + 1)
    rest = 0

    for p in prices[1:]:
        prev_hold = hold
        can_buy = max(rest, sold[-1])
        hold = max(hold, can_buy - p)
        rest = max(rest, sold[-1])

        # shift sold
        curr_sold = prev_hold + p
        sold = [curr_sold] + sold[:-1]

    return max(rest, max(sold))
```

complexity.notes: State machine transitions with circular history buffer of length k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential decision branches if evaluating buy-sell actions recursively.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling array of size k + 1 stores historical sold balances.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses rolling state machine to represent variable cooldown windows.
